issue_title: Promote full looklookAlpha capability profile to a stable release

scope_snapshot.stable_profile: Freeze and validate the full looklookAlpha-required capability profile on a stable ref with exact SHA, schema/capability manifest, workflow identity and fixtures.
scope_snapshot.refresh_contract: Provide start_or_recover semantics keyed by dispatch_correlation_id + idempotency_key + command_digest; recover exact existing workflow operation after ambiguous dispatch/crash; reject conflicting reuse.
scope_snapshot.operation_status: Expose exact run locator and ACCEPTED/QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED without latest-run fallback.
scope_snapshot.artifact_contract: Resolve exactly one primary Alpha snapshot artifact with stable identity and digest; reject missing/conflicting/corrupt artifacts.
scope_snapshot.quality_gate: Cover crash recovery, concurrency isolation, idempotency/conflict, artifact digest, failure/cancel, live-price guard, provenance/freshness compatibility, reusable/full smoke and security gate.
scope_snapshot.release_requirement: No Alpha production integration may depend on unpromoted master-only fields or latest semantics.
